candidateSelection: The single checksum-valid 26-character minikey in the separately registered historical-compatibility replay, selected only by its frozen domain-separated fingerprint; no edited candidates.
queryPolicy: GET every registered address at both providers; 20-second timeout, redirects rejected, no-cache requested. Validate matching address and all five nonnegative safe integer statistics in both chain_stats and mempool_stats. No request failure becomes zero.
addressDerivationPolicy: Two implementations must agree exactly before queries. ASCII minikey SHA256 scalar; public-key compression as declared; P2TR even-Y internal lift and BIP341 TapTweak with no script tree. No HD paths, passwords, arbitrary prose hashes or script guessing.
zeroCriterion: All ten attempts return valid, mutually agreeing all-zero chain and mempool statistics. Scoped to these five mainnet constructions and recorded times.
failurePolicy: Any derivation, control, source/code pin or provider failure/disagreement is inconclusive. Any validated activity triggers private review, not a prize or ownership claim.
controls: Original published30-character minikey and scalar-one five-address vectors
Synthetic26 exact five-address agreement between Node and Python
Frozen complete-result and single26-character-lead summary guards
Public output allowlist and candidate/scalar/address omission guards
publication: Public protocol and all pinned files must exist in the supplied Git commit; root verifies the commit on GitHub before target derivation or live queries. Candidate, scalar, source locators and address association remain private; safe result is explicitly allowlisted.
limitations: The minikey checksum is eight bits; one pass among 207 distinct shapes is compatible with chance (207/256 is about 0.81 expected passes under uniform checks).
Historical 26-character implementation compatibility does not establish author intent or the source-model rule.
The global source envelope permits inconsistent independent membership choices; source-witness review is a separate operation.
Zero history from two explorer operators excludes only the five registered constructions at the recorded times, not every wallet construction or future funding.
No authenticated prize address is known. Activity would not itself authenticate a solution, ownership or 20 BTC.
No HD path, password, arbitrary encoding, wallet import, signing or transaction is included.
Python arithmetic is variable-time and memory clearing is best effort; raw target material is not printed or serialized publicly.
